name: CoreStats
blurb: CoreStats is a system statistics viewer.
description: CoreStats is a system statistics viewer. You can monitor the CPU, RAM, Network and Disk IO statistics from here. It is also possible to view the device info and mount or unmount removable devices, view battery statistics and get information about the display.

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
